title: Comment "Drone" and I'll send you the full setup and prompt 👇 Claude just killed drone videographers
description: Comment "Drone" and I'll send you the full setup and prompt 👇 Claude just killed drone videographers. You can now generate ultra realistic drone footage of anywhere in the world that follows the exact flight path you draw. Here's how: Go to Google Earth, find any spot, zoom in and take a screenshot Draw a line of exactly where you want the drone to fly and save it Google "Higgsfield MCP," click the first result, and copy the link Go to Claude → Customize → Connectors → Add → Add Custom Connector → paste the link Choose Code, upload your screenshot, and paste in the master prompt Make sure Fable 5 is selected, then hit send 10 minutes later Claude generates the most insane drone footage you've ever seen, gliding across the exact path you drew like a real drone actually flew it. Any drone videographer would have charged $10,000 to $20,000 for this. Follow mavgpt for more AI videos. #ai #claude #higgsfield #dronefootage #aitools
